resources.string: Pick a video. It gets trimmed, levelled and colour-corrected on its own. Change anything you disagree with.
When you record something new, AutoCut edits it in the background and saves the result to Movies/AutoCut. The original is never touched.
Access to your videos is needed to notice new recordings.
Automatic mode stays off without access to your videos.

• Dead air at the start and end, and the long pauses in between
• The recording level, brought to a consistent loudness
• Exposure, colour cast, contrast and washed-out colour
• Handheld shake, cancelled frame by frame
• Out-of-focus, frozen, or blank stretches, dropped — lens caps and stalled screen recordings included

Everything happens on your phone. Nothing is uploaded, and the original file is never modified.

AutoCut works entirely on your phone. No account, no upload, no analytics. Your originals are never modified — every edit is written as a new file.
